query: Find 1 US B2B software company with 11–50 employees that is currently hiring an Account Executive.

eligibility.industry: Actual software product sold to business customers, supported by first-party product/customer/activity evidence and mandatory grounded verification. Broad industry category alone is insufficient.
eligibility.geography: Verified company headquarters in the United States; a US job location alone is insufficient.
eligibility.company_size: Current, provider-declared 11–50 employee band from company record; LinkedIn associated-member count is informational. Missing or contradictory size evidence stays UNKNOWN.
eligibility.hiring: Dated, currently open Account Executive posting for this same employer within 30 days of execution; recruiter-on-behalf, undated, stale or adjacent-role postings do not qualify.
eligibility.funding: Not requested; no funding provider purchases authorized.
eligibility.unknown: Never MATCH and never rejected solely for absent evidence. No criteria widening.

limits.any_adoption: Allowed only for an already recorded run ID with no new purchase; count every transport/poll separately. Maximum 5 adoption/poll calls.

preconditions: Separate explicit authorization to run one internal mission in an isolated approved workspace, on an identified integrated commit.
Claude's billing reservation fix and real database/recovery validations pass on that exact commit; replay alone does not establish this.

Every limit has an enforceable pre-purchase/pre-model gate. Proposed caps here are not production configuration. If discovery cannot be bounded to three rows/companies without routing changes, do not start.
All provider/model operations have current price evidence and a conservative maximum including in-flight reservations; unknown price blocks the operation.
Cancellation, stale-owner rejection, durable purchase deduplication and reconciliation demonstrated; operator can read candidate/check, ledger/receipt and terminal audit records.
abort_conditions: Any cap would be exceeded, price is unknown, or credits/reservations/receipts disagree.
Any provider purchase lacks a reservation, repeats a purchased question, or follows cancellation/lost ownership.
Qualification lacks any hard proof, stale evidence becomes current proof, UNKNOWN becomes MATCH, or the request is broadened.
Unexpected provider/model, pending run loses its ID, terminal rows disagree, lease/claim remains held, or deadline/continuation ceiling reached.
stop: At one evidence-supported qualified company or the first cap/abort condition. Cancel new work and reconcile in-flight charges; cancellation is not a refund guarantee. No retries or second mission without review.
readiness: BLOCKED until preconditions verified and separately authorized; no worker/CI/deployment proposal in this artifact.
